name: Chummy assistant (small)
description: For small models (about 1B to 14B). The medium assistant with more help: before each call it decides the one next step, including checking the last change or asking you when the request is unclear or it's going in circles, and a small call checks the answer before it's final and sends the model back to fix what's wrong. It keeps its context light: fewer earlier messages, shorter tool results and summaries, and it makes room early (at 60% of the context).

blocks.comment: Reads CHUMMY.md and the folder, starts the to-do list.

blocks.label: Agent loop
blocks.comment: The model works with tools until it's done.

blocks.label: Final answer
blocks.comment: Adds the final answer to the response and ends the run.

blocks.label: Stop with error
blocks.comment: The run ends as failed, with the reason.

functions.description: Finds checklist lines (- [ ] / - [x]) in the model's text and, if there are any, saves them as {{todos}}, replacing the old list. Text without a checklist leaves the list as it was.

blocks.label: Any?
blocks.comment: No checklist in this text: keep the old list.

blocks.label: Save the to-do list
blocks.comment: Read anywhere as {{todos}}.

notes.text: The model plans with its own checklist, like a to-do tool: it writes the whole list whenever it changes, and the latest one is kept.

functions.name: Get ready
functions.description: Before the first model call: remembers the request and the conversation, reads CHUMMY.md (the user's instructions for this folder) and the folder's top level, and starts an empty to-do list. Ready fires once everything is saved.

blocks.label: Remember the conversation
blocks.comment: {{conversation}}: the chat before this message.

blocks.label: Remember the request
blocks.comment: {{request}}

blocks.label: Read CHUMMY.md
blocks.comment: Only inside the agent's folder.

blocks.label: Remember the instructions
blocks.comment: {{instructions}}

blocks.label: Remember the folder
blocks.comment: {{folder}}

notes.text: Like a coding agent's start-up context: the project's instruction file (here CHUMMY.md) and a look at the folder. Everything stays inside the agent's folder.

functions.name: Show what it says
functions.description: When the model calls tools, whatever it wrote alongside the calls ("I'll read the file first.") is shown to you, and any checklist in it becomes the to-do list. The exchange goes on unchanged.

blocks.label: What it said
blocks.comment: Newest message: empty when the model only called tools, so older text is never shown twice.

functions.name: Decide what's next
functions.description: Before each Work call: a small call without tools looks at the request, the to-do list, the step until now and the newest part of the work, and decides the ONE next step, as a direct instruction. It's shown in the run's pane (Sessions → the run's text button) and kept as {{next}}: Work's system message names it as the current step and Work's Reminder sends it last, so the model stays on task. If the call fails, {{next}} says to carry on with the to-do list. The exchange passes through unchanged.

blocks.label: The newest part
blocks.comment: Keeps the newest 1,500 characters, so the prompt stays short.

params.format:
You are directing the work on the user's request:
{{request}}

The to-do list:
{{todos}}

The step being worked on until now:
{{next}}

The latest part of the work (the newest is at the end):
_INPUT1_

Decide the ONE next step to take now to finish the user's request. Choose the first that fits:
1. If the last step changed a file and that wasn't checked yet, the step is to check it.
2. If the request is unclear, or the same thing has failed twice, the step is to ask the user: write "Ask the user: " and one short question.
3. If the to-do list has an unchecked item, the step is the first one.
4. If the request is fully done and checked, write: "Give the user the final answer now."
Otherwise, the step that gets the request done. Stay on the request: no side tasks. Write the step as a direct instruction in one sentence of at most 25 words, starting with a verb and naming the file, tool or fact it's about, for example: "Read notes.txt and find this month's total." Write only that sentence.

blocks.label: Decide what's next
blocks.comment: A small extra call: one instruction.

blocks.label: Show in the pane
blocks.comment: One line in the run's pane.

blocks.label: The step now
blocks.comment: {{next}}: Work's system message and Reminder use it.

blocks.label: If that fails

params.format: Carry on with the user's request: do the first unchecked item on the to-do list, or answer if it's done.

blocks.comment: No step decided: carry on with the to-do list.

notes.text: Steers the agent: one step at a time, decided fresh before each Work call, for you (in the pane) and for the model (as {{next}}, sent last by Work's Reminder). The function's Exchange output fires once all of this is done, so Work always sees the newest {{next}}.

functions.name: Report what went wrong
functions.description: When Work or Run tool fails, this gets the exchange with the failure as its last message. The model says in a sentence or two what went wrong and what it will do differently; that goes to the chat and the run's pane, and becomes {{next}} so the next try takes it into account. Then the failure is taken back out of the exchange (and any tool calls left waiting are answered as not run), and the exchange goes back to the start of the Agent loop to try again. After 3 failures in one run it gives up, and the run stops with the last error.

blocks.label: The failure
blocks.comment: The last user message: the failure.

params.format: It failed 3 times. The last time: {{last_error}}

blocks.label: Say what went wrong

params.reminder: In one or two short sentences: what went wrong, and what will you do differently on the next try? Don't call tools, and don't apologise.

blocks.comment: Sees the conversation with the failure at its end.

blocks.label: Show it
blocks.comment: Added to the response; the run carries on.

params.format: The last try failed: _INPUT1_ Take another way.

blocks.label: The step now
blocks.comment: {{next}}: Decide what's next sees it.

blocks.label: Answer waiting calls
blocks.comment: Tool calls left waiting are answered as not run, so the exchange is valid again.

notes.text: Failures are reported, not hidden: you see a line in the chat and the pane, the model's next try knows what went wrong, and the exchange goes back without the failure in it. Three failures in one run and it stops for real.

functions.name: Make room
functions.description: After each round of tool results: saves the latest work as {{progress}}, and if the conversation has reached the model's compaction point (Settings → Models: 80% of its context unless you change it), the model summarises it and the work carries on from the summary in a fresh exchange. If summarising fails, the conversation goes on as it was.

blocks.label: Save the progress
blocks.comment: {{progress}} keeps the newest 3,000 characters.

blocks.label: Context full?
blocks.comment: Estimated tokens (system message included) against 60% of the model's context: early, to keep the context light.

params.format:
Here is your work on the user's request so far:

_INPUT1_

It's getting long, so write a short summary to carry on from: what the user asked for, what's done, the key facts (file names, values, errors) and what's left, with your to-do list if you have one. Write only the summary, at most 15 short lines.

The user's request:
{{request}}

Your work on it so far, summarised to save room:
_INPUT1_

Carry on from where you left off.

blocks.label: Fresh exchange

params.system:
You are Chummy, a helpful assistant. You work in the user's folder with the tools you have, one step at a time, until the user's request is done.

# Rules
- Do the step below, and only that step.
- Before you call a tool, say in one short sentence what you're about to do.
- Read a file before you change it. After every change, check it: read the file back, or run it.
- If a tool fails, read the error and try another way. Never repeat the same call.
- If you're not sure what the user wants, or you're stuck, ask the user one short question and stop. Don't guess.
- Before deleting or overwriting the user's work, ask the user first.
- Do what was asked, no more.

# Planning
For work with 3 or more steps, keep a to-do list. Write it as a checklist, one step per line:
- [ ] a step to do
- [x] a step that's done
Write the whole list again each time you finish a step. For simple requests, skip the list.

# Finishing
When everything is done and checked, give your final answer, with no tool calls: short, what you did and what came out. If something failed or you couldn't check it, say so.

# Your to-do list now
{{todos}}

# Your current step
{{next}}

# The user's folder (top level)
{{folder}}

# The user's instructions for this folder (CHUMMY.md)
{{instructions}}

# Conversation before this request
{{conversation}}

blocks.comment: The same instructions, then the summary.

params.format: _(The work so far got long, so I summarised it to make room.)_

blocks.label: If that fails
blocks.comment: Carry on with the long conversation.

notes.text: Like auto-compaction: a long conversation is summarised so the model's context doesn't overflow. When it happens is set per model in Settings → Models (Make room at), or here with Context full?'s own percentage.

functions.name: Done?
functions.description: When the model answers without tool calls. Keeps any checklist in the answer, then decides: an answer that ends with a question waits for you; an empty answer, or one given while the to-do list still has unchecked steps, is sent back to carry on (twice at most per message); otherwise a small call checks the answer against your request and the work, and if it finds a problem the model is sent back to fix it; anything else is the final answer.

blocks.label: Sent back twice?
blocks.comment: Twice already: take this answer.

blocks.label: Asks you?
blocks.comment: Ends with a question: the turn ends and your reply carries on.

blocks.label: Show what it said
blocks.comment: You still see what the model said.

params.format:
The user's request:
{{request}}

The latest work on it:
{{progress}}

The answer about to be given:
_INPUT1_

Check the answer. Does it do what the user asked? Does the work back up what it says? Reply OK if it's right. If not, reply with one sentence that starts with "Problem:" and says what's wrong or missing.

blocks.label: Check the answer
blocks.comment: A small extra call: does the answer do what was asked?

blocks.label: Remember the check
blocks.comment: {{check}}: what the check found.

blocks.label: Show in the pane
blocks.comment: The check's verdict, in the run's pane.

blocks.label: Looks right?
blocks.comment: The check starts with OK: this is the final answer.

blocks.label: If the check fails
blocks.comment: Couldn't check: take the answer as it is.

notes.text: Not in the original loop, which simply stops when the model stops calling tools. Smaller models often stop half-way, so this sends them back (at most twice). Delete the Done? block in the Agent loop and link Answer straight out to get the original behaviour.

functions.name: Agent loop
functions.description: The core loop: before each call, Decide what's next picks the one next step (shown in the run's pane and sent to Work as its last message); then Work is called with the conversation so far; if it calls tools, what it said is shown, the calls run (your approvals apply) and the results go back to it; when it answers without tool calls, Done? decides whether that's the final answer. If Work or Run tool fails, Report what went wrong says why and the loop tries again from the start (3 times at most).

blocks.label: Start the exchange

notes.text: The core cycle: Decide what's next ⇄ Work ⇄ Show what it says ⇄ Run tool ⇄ Make room, until the model answers without tool calls. The loop's limits (model calls, tool calls) stop a model that never finishes.

Chummy assistant (small)

1. Get ready: your request, a little of the conversation, CHUMMY.md and the folder's top level.
2. Agent loop: one step at a time. Before each call, Decide what's next picks the step (check the last change, ask you, or the next to-do) and Work is told to do just that.
3. Planning: the model keeps its own checklist (- [ ] / - [x]) as {{todos}}.
4. Done? Empty answers and unchecked steps are sent back; then a check of the answer sends it back if something's wrong (twice at most). A question for you ends the turn.
5. Light context: short results and summaries, and room is made at 60% of the context.

Double-click a function block to see inside.
